$ archo plan list
plans: 1 (env:main)
  plan:default  4 active  1 version  never played  [current]
next:
  archo plan new <name> --from current

$ archo plan new copy --from current
plan:copy created: 4 active
  v1: import, copied from default v1
  current: plan:default (unchanged)
next:
  archo plan use copy

$ archo plan new blank
plan:blank created: 0 active
  v1: import, empty
  current: plan:default (unchanged)
next:
  archo plan use blank

$ archo plan new listed --from $ROOT/Raid Night.txt
plan:listed created: 4 active
  v1: import, Raid Night.txt
  not installed: 1
  current: plan:default (unchanged)
next:
  archo plan use listed

$ archo loadout import $ROOT/Raid Night.txt --new

  v1: import, Raid Night.txt
  not installed: 1
  current: plan:default (unchanged)
next:
  archo plan use "Raid Night"

$ archo loadout import $ROOT/Raid Night.txt --new night 2

  v1: import, Raid Night.txt
  not installed: 1
  current: plan:default (unchanged)
next:
  archo plan use "night 2"
